card.name: Intravenous bolus versus infusion wording
card.fires_on: The final piece of "bolus" in "intravenous bolus", where "or infusion" or a contrast usually follows. Also weaker on words before an "or" or "rather than" contrast.

modes.label: Intravenous bolus
modes.description: The ending of "bolus" in administration instructions, often "as an intravenous bolus or infusion" or "do not give as a bolus".
